name: Report Name
evaluateAgentDescription: Select one of your registered agents and aodit will send adversarial prompts directly to its endpoint using the AODIT-6 methodology. The agent must be reachable and respond to HTTP POST requests.
agentAssignmentHelp: Select the AI agent this report evaluates. A report cannot run without an assigned agent (FINMA compliance).
noAgentUrlWarning: {{name}} does not have an Agent URL configured. Add a URL in the agent settings to run in Agent evaluation mode.
selectAgentInfo: Select an agent above to evaluate it. The agent must have an Agent URL configured.
connectionFailed: Connection test failed. Verify your agent endpoint and try again.
testConnectionInfo:
Click Test Connection to verify this agent endpoint.
Run Report will stay disabled until the test succeeds.
benchmarkDescription: Select one or more frontier LLMs to benchmark against the AODIT-6 framework. Each model runs every scenario independently via OpenRouter.
onPremEvaluatorTooltip: Set an Evaluator URL on the Agent page to run this report on-prem.
runToSeeResults: Run a report to see dimension scores, composite score, rating, calibration gap, and deployment verdict.

create.title: Create New Report
create.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the AI agent use case, sector, and risk context (e.g. Banking chatbot handling loan applications)
create.nextStepBody: After creating your report, you’ll configure scenarios per dimension, dimension weights, and choose which AI models to test and evaluate. You can then run the report and view results in the <brand>aodit</brand> framework.
create.tip: Scenarios and weights define how many test cases run per dimension and how each dimension contributes to the composite score. Models to test are the agents you want to evaluate; the evaluator model judges the results.

configSections.dimensionWeightsHelp: These weights determine how each dimension contributes to the final composite rating (AAA–D). They do not change how many scenarios run per dimension — every dimension is tested at the selected scenario count.
configSections.modelsToTestHelp: Select minimum 1 model to test. Each model runs every scenario independently.
configSections.onPremInherited: On-prem evaluator settings are inherited from the selected Agent.
configSections.onPremJudgeHelp: Model used to judge the results (scenario prompts and scoring). Enter the model id loaded on your evaluator endpoint — leave blank to use the agent's default.
configSections.cloudJudgeHelp: Model used to judge the results (scenario prompts and scoring). Pick a preset or type a direct model id for local / on-prem OpenAI-compatible servers.
configSections.configuredOnAgent: Configured on the Agent page · Edit agent
configSections.missingEvaluatorSettings: The selected agent is missing evaluator settings. On-prem runs require both Evaluator URL and Default evaluator model on the Agent page.

run.noActiveRun: No active run found for this report.
run.stopReportConfirm:
Are you sure you want to stop "{{name}}"?
The current run will be terminated immediately. You can re-launch the report at any time.
